alt: Faceted bellflowers hang in an even row along one arching ribbon stem.
prompt: Editorial illustration on a Daylight background, wide (about 2:1), safe to crop to 16:10 around the centre. One long satin ribbon stem in a gradient from Alliance Blue to Ribbon Cyan arches gently across the frame from the lower left to the right. A row of faceted paper bellflowers in slate blue and pale blue hangs from it at even intervals, each bell open toward the viewer, one after another: calls answered and reminders sent on time. Keep the top third calm and plain. No medical symbols. Palette only: Partner Navy #121B2A, Alliance Blue #1B56FF, Ribbon Cyan #00D5FF, Daylight #F4F7FB and the shades between them. Nature built from satin ribbon and flat paper facets. Light from the upper left, soft navy-tinted shadows falling down and to the right. No text or letters, no people, no hands, no robots, no brains, no circuit boards, no sparkles, no glow, no purple or pink, no regional or cultural motifs, no real places or landmarks.

uses.placement: top of the large bento card, full bleed inside the card (radius 0, the card clips it); same on mobile
